items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: I played there with Ori on several occasions.

ctx.x: I saw him last summer. Living. Yeah, he looks good. I don't know about that. Works in a steel mill, still works hard.
Now, what do you know about that? He does. Yes, indeed. That was my first band I played with. Now, my next band I played with was sitting in a guy's place was with Ori's band.
Well, before we get into that, what I meant to say when you started out, I meant how old were you when you first started?
